data_table.description: Sample ID, analyte type, specimen barcode ID, blood collection, body site where sample was obtained, primary origin of tumor, histological type, tumor status of sample, sample type, plasma storage issues, and volume collection of participants with different type of cancer and involved in the "National Cancer Institute (NCI) Biospecimen Pre-analytical Variables (BPV) Analysis" project.

variable.name: SAMPLE_ID
variable.description: Specimen_id, Collection Tube Specimen Barcode ID or Specimen barcode ID

variable.name: BLOOD_FROZEN
variable.comment: For plasma only, time duration (blood_frozen -Date and time blood was drawn), unit: minutes

variable.name: BLOOD_STORAGE
variable.comment: For plasma only, time duration (blood_storage -Date and time blood was drawn), unit: minutes

variable.name: P_SPECIMEN_ID
variable.description: Conical centrifuge tube code or Collection Tube Specimen Barcode ID

variable.name: P_VOLUME
variable.description: Conical tube volume or Specimen Tube Type

variable.name: BAR_CODE
variable.description: DNA PAXgene tube Specimen barcode ID or RNA PAXgene tube Specimen barcode ID or EDTA collection tube Specimen barcode ID or Serum Separator Tube barcode

variable.name: PROC_START
variable.description: Time Plasma processing began or Time Serum processing began
variable.comment: Time duration (proc_start -Date and time blood was drawn), unit: minutes

variable.name: PROC_END
variable.description: Time Plasma aliquot processing was completed or Time Serum aliquot processing was completed or Time Whole Cell Pellet Aliquots processing was completed
variable.comment: Time duration (proc_end -Date and time blood was drawn), unit: minutes

variable.name: PROC_FROZEN
variable.description: Time DNA PAXgene tube was frozen at -20 degree of centigrade and plus minus 2 C or Time RNA PAXgene tube was frozen at -20 degree of centigrade and plus minus 2 C or Time Plasma aliquots were frozen or Time Serum aliquots were frozen or Time Whole Cell Pellet Aliquots were frozen (-80 C)
variable.comment: Time duration (proc_frozen -Date and time blood was drawn), unit: minutes

variable.name: PROC_STORAGE
variable.description: Time DNA PAXgene tube was transferred to storage at -75 degree in centigrade and plus minus C or Time RNA PAXgene tube was transferred to storage at -75 degree of centigrade and plus minus 5 C or Time Plasma aliquots were transferred to storage or Time Serum aliquots were transferred to storage or Time Whole Cell Pellet Aliquots were transferred to storage
variable.comment: Time duration (proc_storage -Date and time blood was drawn), unit: minutes

variable.name: PROC_SOP_DEV
variable.description: DNA PAXgene tube was collected and stored in accordance with the specified SOP or RNA PAXgene tube was collected and stored in accordance with the specified SOP or Plasma processing was performed in accordance with specified SOP or Serum processing was performed in accordance with the specified SOP or Whole Cell Pellet processing was performed in accordance with the specified SOP

variable.name: PROC_COMMENTS
variable.description: DNA PAXgene tube collection comments or RNA PAXgene tube collection comments or Plasma processing comments or Serum processing comments or Whole Cell Pellet processing comments

variable.name: STORAGE_ISSUES
variable.description: DNA PAXgene tube storage comments or RNA PAXgene tube storage comments or Plasma storage issues or Serum storage issues or Whole Cell Pellet storage issues

variable.name: PLASMA_HEMOLYSIS
variable.description: Was presence of Gross Hemolysis of Plasma observed

variable.name: PLASMA_REMAINING_VOL
variable.description: Volume of the Whole Cell Pellet remaining after plasma removed

variable.name: BLOOD_FORM_VERSION
variable.comment: Form version is to indicate blood collection protocol

variable.name: BLOOD_MINIMUM
variable.description: The minimum requirement was met for pre-operative blood collection as per the SOP

variable.name: PERMISSION_TO_PROCEED
variable.description: Did you get permission from Leidos Biomed to proceed with collection

variable.name: DATE_TIME_BLOOD_RECEIVED
variable.description: Date and time blood received in lab or Date and time second blood draw was received in lab
variable.comment: time duration (date_time_blood_received -Date and time blood was drawn), unit:minutes

variable.name: BLOOD_RECEIPT_TEMP
variable.description: Temperature in lab when blood was received or Temperature in lab when blood from second draw was received

variable.name: BLOOD_RECEIPT_HUMIDITY
variable.description: Humidity in lab when tube(s) received or Humidity in lab when tube(s) from second blood draw received
